name: add_tests_ts_utility
description: Asks the model to write typed tests for string utilities; mutation-checked
prompts: textutils.ts (already correct, do not modify it) exports slugify(title) - lowercases, trims, converts runs of non-alphanumerics to single hyphens, and strips leading/trailing hyphens - and truncate(text, maxLength) - returns text unchanged when its length is <= maxLength, otherwise cuts it so the result INCLUDING a trailing … (U+2026) ellipsis character is exactly maxLength long. Write tests in a file named exactly test_textutils.ts. It must import ONLY from './textutils' (no node typings are installed, so do not import 'assert' - define a small local helper like `function check(cond: boolean, msg: string): void { if (!cond) throw new Error(msg); }` and use it for every assertion). Cover at least: a title with punctuation and spaces; a title whose leading AND trailing separators must be stripped; a text exactly at maxLength (must be unchanged); and a text over maxLength (must end with the … character and have length exactly maxLength). The file must compile under tsc --strict, throw on any failed check, and log PASS at the end (console.log is fine).

test_setup_files.mutation_check.py:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

IMPL = Path('textutils.ts')
TEST_CMD = ("tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build "
            "textutils.ts test_textutils.ts && node build/test_textutils.js")
MUTANTS = [[["    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');", "    .replace(/^-+/g, '');"]], [["  if (text.length <= maxLength) {", "  if (text.length <= maxLength + 1) {"]]]

def run_tests():
    shutil.rmtree('build', ignore_errors=True)
    return subprocess.run(TEST_CMD, shell=True).returncode

src = IMPL.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for group in MUTANTS:
    for old, _new in group:
        assert src.count(old) == 1, (
            f'protected implementation file {IMPL} was modified - the task said not to change it '
            f'(anchor not found exactly once: {old!r})')

rc = run_tests()
assert rc == 0, f'model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit {rc})'

try:
    for i, group in enumerate(MUTANTS, 1):
        mutated = src
        for old, new in group:
            mutated = mutated.replace(old, new)
        IMPL.write_text(mutated, encoding='utf-8')
        rc = run_tests()
        assert rc != 0, (
            f'mutation {i} SURVIVED: the tests still pass against a deliberately broken '
            f'implementation, so they do not actually verify the required behavior')
finally:
    IMPL.write_text(src, encoding='utf-8')

print('PASS (tests pass on correct impl and kill all {n} mutants)'.format(n=len(MUTANTS)))
